description: Check an ApexTree config against what the library does with it: root is a NestedNode, every node has an id and a label, children (when present) is an array, ids unique across the whole tree, valid direction/edgeStyle/edgeColorMode/theme values, enableSelection is "single"|"multi"|false (NOT boolean true), and a warning when contentKey is "data" but a node has no `data` payload. Accepts both the wrapped `{ options, data }` shape and a bare root node.
name: apextree_validate_config
title: Validate ApexTree config
